name: S.I.S.T.A.R.S:KISS OF TRINITY
source: Older brother (nameable) has two younger twin sisters, Luna and Sol. Luna is a brocon who wants to have sex with her onii-chan while Sol is high spirited and enjoys teasing both her siblings. The twins both propose to onii-chan to become his lovers.
translation: 哥哥（可命名）有两个双胞胎妹妹——露娜和索尔。露娜是一个兄控，想和哥哥做爱；索尔则性格活泼，喜欢捉弄她的兄姐。双胞胎都向哥哥提议成为他的恋人。
